\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 173-175 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R178-first-pass-words-from-chapters-173-175}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a pencil case and a school report.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item silver, copper, plastic, cloth, leather
  \item a kitchen cabinet, a kitchen sink, a colander, a sugar bowl, a salt cellar
  \item a lighter, a dustpan, a socket, a vacuum cleaner, a washing machine
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Silver? (\textbf{\fa{نقره}}, \emph{noqre}.) Copper? (\textbf{\fa{مس}}, \emph{mes}.) Plastic? (\textbf{\fa{پلاستیک}}, \emph{plâstik}.) Cloth? (\textbf{\fa{پارچه}}, \emph{pârche}.) Leather? (\textbf{\fa{چرم}}, \emph{charm}.) A kitchen cabinet? (\textbf{\fa{کابینت}}, \emph{kâbinet}.) A kitchen sink? (\textbf{\fa{ظرفشویی}}, \emph{zarfshuyi}.) A colander? (\textbf{\fa{آبکش}}, \emph{âbkesh}.) A sugar bowl? (\textbf{\fa{قندان}}, \emph{qandân}.) A salt cellar? (\textbf{\fa{نمکدان}}, \emph{namakdân}.) A lighter? (\textbf{\fa{فندک}}, \emph{fandak}.) A dustpan? (\textbf{\fa{خاک} \fa{انداز}}, \emph{khâkandâz}.) A socket? (\textbf{\fa{پریز}}, \emph{periz}.) A vacuum cleaner? (\textbf{\fa{جاروبرقی}}, \emph{jârubarqi}.) A washing machine? (\textbf{\fa{لباسشویی}}, \emph{lebâsshuyi}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 176-178 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R178-second-pass-words-from-chapters-176-178}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a profession and a company.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a profession, a company, a factory, a meeting, a salary
  \item a passenger, a guide, leave, a subject of study, a course
  \item a stapler, a folder, an eraser, a pencil case, a school report
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A profession? (\textbf{\fa{حرفه}}, \emph{herfe}.) A company? (\textbf{\fa{شرکت}}, \emph{sherkat}.) A factory? (\textbf{\fa{کارخانه}}, \emph{kârkhâne}.) A meeting? (\textbf{\fa{جلسه}}, \emph{jalase}.) A salary? (\textbf{\fa{حقوق}}, \emph{hoquq}.) A passenger? (\textbf{\fa{مسافر}}, \emph{mosâfer}.) A guide? (\textbf{\fa{راهنما}}, \emph{râhnamâ}.) Leave? (\textbf{\fa{مرخصی}}, \emph{morakhkhasi}.) A subject of study? (\textbf{\fa{رشته}}, \emph{reshte}.) A course? (\textbf{\fa{دوره}}, \emph{dowre}.) A stapler? (\textbf{\fa{منگنه}}, \emph{mangane}.) A folder? (\textbf{\fa{پوشه}}, \emph{pushe}.) An eraser? (\textbf{\fa{پاک} \fa{کن}}, \emph{pâkkon}.) A pencil case? (\textbf{\fa{جامدادی}}, \emph{jâmedâdi}.) A school report? (\textbf{\fa{کارنامه}}, \emph{kârnâme}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
